Thank You

for being here, for caring, for contributing

This page exists because you matter. Whether you're here to contribute code, learn how something works, fork this for your own use, or just see what someone in Iowa is building—thank you for your time and attention.

In a world of infinite content, the fact that you're reading this means something. Every visitor, every star, every fork, every bug report makes this project better and helps someone else down the line.

Why This Matters

**Open source thrives on contribution.** Every bug report, documentation improvement, and shared idea makes this better for everyone.

**Learning in public helps others learn.** Your questions become someone else's answers. Your mistakes become teaching moments.

**Community starts with care.** The Code of Conduct isn't rules for rules' sake—it's how we create space for everyone to contribute their gifts.

**Gratitude sustains the work.** The Special Thanks page isn't nostalgia—it's acknowledging that we build on the shoulders of giants.

How You Can Help

⭐ Star the repository on GitHub
🐛 Report bugs or suggest features
🍴 Fork it and build your own
💬 Share feedback or ask questions
